items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: And that's when Constant Lambert was there

ctx.x: That's it, yeah. Well, listen, if I remember correctly, that first trip to England was the first time the band had ever gave a concert. I think -- you were playing a theater or something. I may be wrong on this, Cootie, but I remember that you had to give a Sunday afternoon concert, in a concert hall. And that's when Constant Lambert was there, the big classical composer, and so on. And did -- you know, he wrote a lot of wonderful things about the band and about Duke as a composer. And I think that was the first…
I can't remember it, you know. Too clearly.
